title: Almond Crusted Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry with a crunchy almond crust. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until they begin to soften.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, then add the almonds and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, or until they are lightly toasted.
Add the soy sauce and stir-fry sauce, and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
